rationale: For a crypto trading dashboard, users require high visibility, command-center focus, and elite precision. Dark theme prevents eye strain during long sessions, while high-contrast accents enable quick decision-making.

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Tactical Minimalism. Flat solid backgrounds, 1px solid border (border-white/10), no soft shadows. Sharp edges or max 4px border radius. No glassmorphism.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border, no shadow. Hover: slight border color brighten. Use 'border-collapse' style grid where possible.
components.buttons: High-saturation accent blocks. No rounded pills, use rounded-md or sharp corners.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn chart components. Use high-contrast stroke colors against the dark background. No generic gradients.
components.tables: Dense. Use JetBrains mono for numerical columns. Right-align numbers.
components.navigation: Side or top nav. Solid background with hard bottom/right border.

motion.hover: Explicitly set hover text color. Hover state color must be a lighter hue.

image_urls.description: Abstract minimalist logo for Nexus Trader
Dark tech geometric background for auth screens
Abstract neon blue geometry for AI agent visual representation
Trading chart contextual image for onboarding or empty states

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons for dense dashboard and developer tools look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind for dark mode by default.
Implement the layout using CSS Grid with exact gap-4 and dense utilization of space (Control Room Grid).
Use Manrope for headings and JetBrains Mono for body and tabular data.
Make sure all numbers (prices, percentages) use JetBrains Mono to keep columns aligned.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. Stick to Tactical Minimalism with 1px solid borders.
Ensure the AI Trading Agent Status section has a glowing/active aesthetic, using the Volt Blue color and a radar/pulse animation.
Do NOT use placeholder text for logos; always use the provided image URLs.
